mapper.insert: insert into register ( register_no, register_id, register_password, register_name, register_email, register_phone, register_date ) values ( register_seq.nextval, #{registerId}, #{registerPassword}, #{registerName}, #{registerEmail}, #{registerPhone}, sysdate )
mapper.select: SELECT register_no AS registerNo, register_id AS registerId, register_password AS registerPassword, register_name AS registerName, register_email AS registerEmail, register_phone AS registerPhone, TO_CHAR(register_date, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS registerDate FROM register WHERE register_id = #{registerId} AND register_password = #{registerPassword}
mapper.update: UPDATE register SET register_password = #{registerPassword}, register_name = #{registerName}, register_email = #{registerEmail}, register_phone = #{registerPhone} WHERE register_no = #{registerNo}
